en: Ruy López de Villalobos named the archipelago "Las Islas Filipinas," not Ferdinand Magellan who arrived earlier.
Emilio Aguinaldo was the first president of the Philippines, not national hero Jose Rizal.
Emilio Aguinaldo designed the Philippine flag in Hong Kong, rather than it being created by American colonizers.
The Philippines celebrates Independence Day on June 12 to honor the 1898 declaration, not on July 4.
The Sampaguita is the official national flower of the Philippines, not the rare Waling-waling orchid.
The legislative branch makes the laws through Congress, whereas the President leads the executive branch.
Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan secret society, not Jose Rizal who advocated for peaceful reforms.
The Sinulog festival in Cebu honors the Santo Niño, rather than celebrating the arrival of Ferdinand Magellan.
Dr. Fe del Mundo was the first female student admitted to Harvard Medical School, not just a regular local physician.
The Philippines is an archipelago of 7,641 islands, not a single continuous landmass connected to mainland Asia.
The Igorot people are diverse indigenous groups from the Cordillera mountains, not a single unified tribe.
The Philippine peso originated during the Spanish colonial period, not the American occupation as many mistakenly believe.
